item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 03/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of southern China will be gradually replaced by a warm and humid southerly airstream in the next couple of days. It will be misty in the morning and at night over the region. A cold front is expected to develop and move across the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. There will be showers and a few thunderstorms over the region. Temperatures will fall slightly. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will improve gradually over the coastal areas of Guangdong during the weekend.
